cohort: 1,636 nulliparous women induced for postdates pregnancies (≥41 weeks)
finding: Nulliparous women of Black ethnicity had a 3.26 times greater likelihood of cesarean section delivery compared to White women, after adjusting for maternal age, BMI, smoking, presence of meconium, use of epidural analgesia, fetal gender, birth weight, and head circumference.
mod_finding: Nulliparous women of Black ethnicity have an almost threefold increased risk of cesarean section delivery when induced for postdates pregnancy compared to White women.
